'''Doreille Torghin''' was the former Queen of [[Aridhol]].

== History ==
[[Matrim Cauthon]] remembers seeing her standing on a balcony watching over a battle in the Splintered Hills.

== Works ==
Among other poems, she wrote ''[[The Wheel Turns (poem)|The Wheel Turns]]'' which was the basis for at least three songs.
